title: What's New: Item Substitution with Copilot (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Copilot availability, deployment, and safety standards

features.name: Item substitution with Copilot
features.description: Copilot feature that automatically suggests substitute items based on the primary item's description, using LLM to extract keywords and embeddings to re-rank results with confidence scores.
caveats: Requires good item description for effective results
Tested in English only, untested in other languages
Consolidated table for search is updated periodically with potential delays
Only available in cloud version of Business Central, not on-premise
Part of the planned functionality was postponed for future release

features.name: Suggest with Copilot action
features.description: User action on the item substitution page that triggers Copilot to generate a list of substitute item candidates with confidence scores.

features.name: Search mode options
features.description: Three search modes for item substitution results: Balance (default, at least one main search term required), Permissive (any search term sufficient), and Precise (all search terms required).

features.name: Prompt customization
features.description: Users can adjust the search prompt to refine substitution suggestions, such as adding additional criteria like color to narrow results.

features.name: Sales line suggestion with Copilot
features.description: Related Copilot feature that suggests sales lines, released in the previous wave with new enhancements in this release.
features.status_evidence_quote: This functionality was released already in the previous wave

features.name: Data search enhancement
features.description: Platform team delivered data search improvements used by item substitution feature and available across the product.

features.name: Create product information capability toggle
features.description: Copilot and AI capabilities page setting to enable item substitution feature. Named 'create product information' as placeholder for larger feature set initially planned.
caveats: Initial planned functionality was partially postponed to future release due to responsible AI standards verification
